company.name: Last Accounting Company
company.shortDescription: Last Accounting Company provides AI-assisted bookkeeping, tax filings, payroll, and financial reporting as one service.
company.description: Last Accounting Company provides bookkeeping, payroll, VAT and tax filings, financial statements, consolidations, invoice processing, and accounting advisory as one service. The company combines these services with an accounting platform that connects banks, payment providers, business systems, documents, and tax authorities to a general ledger. Its Björn accounting agent handles selected manual processes, while human accountants review results. The platform also provides MCP and REST API access for financial data, documents, reports, invoice actions, and defined accounting workflows.
